_comment_case: Stage 2 of the Chlamydomonas validation plan: ONE flagellum on the cell body.
Purpose: calibrate the traveling-wave active moment (amplitude_Nm, wavenumber)
against the measured waveform (Geyer 2016 / Sartori 2016: static curvature
0.24 rad/um, tangent-angle amplitude 0.68 rad, wavelength ~11.5 um, L = 11.7 um).
amplitude_Nm is a STARTING VALUE; chlamydomonas/chlamy_calibrate_single.m scans it.

custom_geometry._comment_body: Prolate spheroid c = 5 um (X), a = 4 um (Pradipta et al. 2025, CC-125); 400 surface points.
custom_geometry._comment_sites: Basal bodies 0.5 um apart (ASSUMED); root half-angle 40 deg (ASSUMED). Site 1 = +Y flagellum.

pili._comment: Flagellum on +Y side. frozen = rest shape is the static arc (C0 = 0.24 rad/um). Beat plane = XY: d2 = +Z, so the bending moment is d2_amp = 1.

_comment_material: Axoneme + membrane hydrodynamic radius 0.125 um.  E is an EFFECTIVE modulus chosen so that
EI = E*pi*r^4/4 = 840 pN um^2 (intrinsic axonemal rigidity, Xu et al. 2016, CC-124).
sigma_p only affects twist, which a planar beat does not excite.
_comment_fluid: Water, mu = 1 mPa s (as in Pradipta et al.).  Neutrally buoyant: swimming only, no sedimentation.

simulation._comment_T_obs: 6 beats at 50 Hz.  Discard the first 1-2 beats (start-up transient from the initial phase).
simulation._comment_dt: dt is only the output sampling stride: 1 ms = 20 frames per beat.
